purpose: Teach: 末端/因子/ますれ/買い上げ/係数/番外/不振/とりあげ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究は末端の事象も大事だ
lines.en: Ren — in research, even the peripheral details matter.
lines.style: Measured opening. Light emphasis on 「大事」. Patient mentor tone, not lecturing. Eyes steady on Ren. Lean slightly forward with the weight of experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。原因因子の整理を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on organizing the causal factors.
lines.style: Respectful, focused. Slight nod accompanies the opening. Quiet confidence underneath — showing he's taking it seriously. Clean, direct delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、相談したい事ますれば、いつでも来い
lines.en: Ren — if there's anything you want to talk through, come find me anytime.
lines.style: Warmth beneath the formality. Slight soften on 「いつでも」. Not just instruction now — an opening of the door. Eye contact that says he means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。文献の買い上げリストを作成します
lines.en: Yes. I'll use supplementary papers as learning material too.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slightly quickened tempo showing eagerness to act. Small breath before the second part — showing he's thinking beyond what was just said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、相関係数を慎重に解釈しろ
lines.en: Ren — interpret the correlation coefficients carefully.
lines.style: Firmer now, more directive. Weight on 「慎重に」. Not unkind, but the tone shifts to caution. Slight pause before the object — letting it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。番外論文も学びの素材にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll treat papers outside the mainstream as material for learning.
lines.style: Earnest agreement with a hint of aspiration. Pace steady but engaged. Shows he understood the broader lesson, not just the directive. Clean close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、不振研究室の事例も学べ
lines.en: Ren — study the cases of labs that have struggled too.
lines.style: Direct, unhurried. Slight gravity here — acknowledging setback is part of the path. Not pessimistic, but honest. Pause after 「蓮」 to ensure attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会誌にとりあげられる論文を目指します
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming to produce work that gets published in the major journals.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Longer phrase shows he's internalized the larger vision. Small breath at the comma. Finality at the close without arrogance — just commitment.
